description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayDiscoveryModel component of the OpenClawDiscovery module, focusing on gateway identification, parsing, and discovery logic.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModelTests
classes.description: A struct containing multiple test functions to validate gateway discovery logic.

methods.name: `local gateway matches lan host`
methods.description: Tests if the local gateway is correctly identified based on LAN host token.

methods.name: `local gateway matches tailnet dns`
methods.description: Tests recognition of local gateway via tailnet DNS name.

methods.name: `local gateway matches display name`
methods.description: Tests identification of local gateway using display name tokens.

methods.name: `remote gateway does not match`
methods.description: Ensures non-matching gateways are correctly identified as remote.

methods.name: `local gateway matches service name`
methods.description: Tests if gateway service name enables local gateway detection.

methods.name: `service name does not false positive on substring host token`
methods.description: Verifies no false positives when service name contains substring of a host token.

methods.name: `parses gateway TXT fields`
methods.description: Validates parsing of gateway TXT record fields into structured data.

methods.name: `parses gateway TXT defaults`
methods.description: Checks default values when parsing missing or invalid TXT fields.

methods.name: `builds SSH target`
methods.description: Tests construction of SSH target string based on user, host, and port.

methods.name: `tailscale serve discovery continues when DNS-SD already found a remote gateway`
methods.description: Validates continuation logic of DNS-SD gateway discovery.

methods.name: `tailscale serve discovery stops after serve result is found`
methods.description: Ensures discovery process halts once a gateway is identified.

methods.name: `dedupe key prefers resolved endpoint across sources`
methods.description: Checks that deduplication favors gateways with resolved endpoints.

methods.name: `dedupe key falls back to stable ID without endpoint`
methods.description: Verifies fallback behavior for deduplication when no endpoint info is available.
